question: Choose the antonym of 'authorize"
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1 (Forbid)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"authorize"** means to give official permission or approval for something. (अधिकार देना)

 
 
• **Example:** The manager authorized the use of the company’s credit card for the purchase.
 
 
 
• **"Forbid"** refers to refusing to allow something or prohibiting an action. (मनाही करना)
 
 
• **Example:** The school forbids students from using mobile phones during class hours.
 
 
 
• Hence, the opposite of **"authorize"** is **"forbid"**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1 (Forbid)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Allow** (अनुमति देना): To let someone do something or to permit an action.

 
 
• **Example:** The teacher allowed the students to take a break after the test.
 
 
 
• **Empower** (सशक्त करना): To give someone the authority or power to do something.
 
 
• **Example:** The new policy empowers employees to make decisions without prior approval.
 
 
 
• **Permit** (अनुमति देना): To officially allow something to happen.
 
 
• **Example:** The city council permitted the construction of the new library.
